Event 496 Scouting

Event 496 Scouting · Disrespect The 5

Leetify and FACEIT data pulled 9 Nov 2026 · 47 teams, 235 players
How to read the numbers

Rating is this report's own composite, on the FACEIT Elo scale. Level is the player's FACEIT Elo blended with his Premier rating converted to an Elo equivalent, weighted by how many of his last 100 matches were on each (league matches count on the FACEIT side). It is then moved by at most 250 for how his HLTV rating in FACEIT and Premier matches compares with what is typical at that level. Players hidden on Leetify get their FACEIT Elo unadjusted. Team rating is the average of the players with a rating.

HLTV rating is HLTV Rating 2.0 computed with the standard published approximation over a player's last 30 matches tracked on Leetify. It is calculated here, not taken from hltv.org. CT and T ratings are on Leetify's scale (0 is average, +2 strong) because HLTV rating cannot be split by side from this data. Retake, afterplant and opening impact are Leetify rating contributions in those phases; negative means rounds lost there.

Team-play numbers come from recent matches where at least three roster members were on the same side. Opening % is the share of opening duels won on that side. Sniper % and entry % come from FACEIT lifetime stats: share of kills with a sniper, and share of rounds taking the first duel. Field ranks run from the highest value (1st) to the lowest, out of 47 teams, or the 35 with five or more shared matches for team-play stats.

Priorities and plays: eleven play types are scored against each opponent's tendencies (CT aggression, AWP use, retake and afterplant results, opening duels, utility volume and timing, trading, clutching). The top types per side are the priorities, and the Plays tab shows the matching play on every map. The "fits" line lists the tendencies behind each choice; "baseline" means a standard play with nothing specific behind it. Our edge on a map compares our results there with theirs in percentage points, pulling small samples toward each roster's individual win rate.

Limits. Leetify history is capped at a player's last 100 matches and hidden profiles show FACEIT data only. Neither site records positions or bombsite results, so where a named player stands is the map default until a demo or the first rounds confirm it. Reads, styles and plays are generated from the numbers by fixed rules.
